record.hypothesis: Across all four datasets, reduce history-item frequency attenuation from 1-0.3*feature to 1-0.2*feature. Keep feature=sqrt(log1p(training_count)/max_log_count), since both neighboring exponent changes regressed. Weaker attenuation may retain useful signals from common observed items. Use training counts only, preserve zero features for unseen items, and keep embeddings, topology, readout, scoring, loss and optimizer fixed. Apply the identical feature transformation during prediction.

category_rationales.rationale: Weaker attenuation may preserve useful signals from common history items across all four datasets. Retain the square-root normalized log training-count feature and zero values for unseen items. The generated predictor imports this same model class and restores its feature buffer, so the transformation stays identical during training and inference.
